name: 原则：边界纪律
description_zh: 在接线校验、错误处理或框架适配器时：把守卫集中在系统边界（CLI、配置、网络、外部 API）；信任内部类型，业务逻辑留在纯函数里。
description_en: Apply when wiring validation, error handling, or framework adapters. Concentrate guards at system boundaries (CLI, config, network, external APIs); trust internal types and keep business logic in pure functions.
